text:
jamie: Quick heads-up — quiet window tomorrow 21:00 UTC for py/ts SDK cutover. We need dist-tag handoff, final changelog push, and a hold on publishing GA until signoff. Can deploy-bot hold the canary and only proceed after :thumbsup: from release team?

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for 2024-07-12T21:05:00Z (can be paused). To pause run `/deploy pause canary 4867001234` or reply `pause`.

maria: I’ll take dist-tag handoff. Plan: canary (21:05) -> shadow traffic 30m -> GA (21:45). I'll verify artifacts and checksums. :white_check_mark:

lina: Docs are updated. Need one line in release notes about deprecating the legacy sync client and a migration snippet for TypeScript.

siva: I'll update example templates and pin the example to the last-major so it doesn't auto-upgrade. For npm: ```npm i @redwood/sdk@^2.3.1 --save-exact``` for pip: ```pip install redwood-sdk==2.3.1```

ops: Monitoring watches: if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m we auto-rollback. Also will keep an eye on latency P95. I'll stand by at 21:00 UTC.

release-bot: Changelog draft uploaded: https://drive.releases/redwood-sdk/4867001234-changelog.md — requesting review.

jamie: OK — maria will do the dist-tag sequence. @maria please don't flip `latest` until we confirm shadow metrics. When ready run:
```
# stage next tag
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.4.0 next
# after signoff
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.4.0 latest
```

maria: Got it. I'll post the GA comment and changelog link when ready. If anything flaps during shadow I'll pause the canary and call rollback.

lina: Added the migration snippet to the docs and release notes draft.

siva: Quick note — QA noticed one flaky test in `examples/chat` that's unrelated to release but could confuse users. I'll disable it in examples before GA.

jamie: Perfect. If everyone is aligned we'll treat this as the plan. React with :thumbsup: to lock the window.

maria: :thumbsup:

lina: :thumbsup:

siva: :thumbsup:

ops: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary paused (awaiting manual proceed).
